The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a grave decoration which provides +7 {{Grave Decor}} when placed on a [[gravesite]], after a [[corpse]] has been buried there. Installing or uninstalling any grave decoration costs {{Energy|5}}. Unlike lower-tier decorations, marble decor can ''not'' be recycled. For more information, see [[graveyard]].
